backend-platform.label: Backend platform on-call
backend-platform.scope: API, workers, queues, telemetry bootstrap, generation orchestration

document-generation.label: Document generation owner
document-generation.scope: Template registry, artifact loading, renderer output, generation-run state

storage-platform.label: Storage platform owner
storage-platform.scope: Supabase storage buckets, signed URLs, document/signature object IO

web-app.label: Web app owner
web-app.scope: Next.js app, browser/server/edge Sentry, member review/signing UI

notary-operations.label: Notary operations owner
notary-operations.scope: Notary handoff, request review, in-person meeting, final package workflow

alertRules.description: Any production event that blocks document generation or signing finalization for a critical document path.
Storage dependency failures that can block uploads, downloads, signature assets, or generated document persistence.
Generation/template failures outside the P0 single-event set, including data integrity misses.
Signing/notarization errors affecting member signing, notary handoff, review decisions, meeting evidence, or finalization.
Web review/sign/notary UX failures that may leave users unable to continue a critical workflow.
Unclassified errors indicate a gap in the first-class error contract and should be triaged into a stable code.
Release health guardrail for new error-code deltas after deploy.
Synthetic telemetry smoke event used to verify deploy-time Sentry tag/context shape.

releaseHealthGuardrails.p0Policy: Pause rollout and page backend-platform on the first current-release P0 event.
releaseHealthGuardrails.p1Policy: Open incident review when current-release P1 count is at least 5 and 50% above the previous 24-hour baseline for the same error_code/family.
releaseHealthGuardrails.correlationPolicy: Do not promote when more than 2% of critical-flow events are missing request_id, document_id, or generation_run_id where applicable.
releaseHealthGuardrails.unknownCodePolicy: Treat UNCLASSIFIED_ERROR or missing error_code as P1 until classified.

checks: Inspect the acknowledgment text length, page size, signature image, and seal image for the affected finalization attempt.
Reproduce the appendix render and confirm that it still creates a second page after the renderer retries font sizes from 12 through 8 points.
mitigations: Correct unexpectedly verbose or malformed acknowledgment content, then retry finalization without changing the completed signing evidence.
If valid jurisdiction text cannot fit, adjust the approved one-page appendix layout or image reservation rules and verify the resulting acknowledgment before requeueing affected finalizations.

checks: Confirm the Sentry event contains service, operation, error_code, error_family, request_id, synthetic, and smoke_test tags.
Confirm the event fingerprint is backend/internal/OBSERVABILITY_SMOKE_EVENT/observability.smoke.
mitigations: If the dry-run shape is correct but Sentry does not receive the event, check SENTRY_DSN, SENTRY_ENABLED, environment, and network egress.
If tags or fingerprint are missing, block deployment until telemetry helpers are repaired.

checks: Open the Sentry event and copy templateKey, outputKey, templateArtifactId, documentId, generationRunId, and request_id.
Verify the active template artifact points at deployed markdown source and that the template key is in the expected release.
mitigations: Rollback the template registry/artifact pointer to the last known source-backed artifact.
If only one output is affected, block that output/jurisdiction combination until source is restored.

checks: Compare outputKey/templateKey against template_registry and the deployed artifact metadata.
Check whether fallback rendering is intentionally disabled or missing canonical answers for the output.
mitigations: Restore a source-backed artifact or deploy the missing template source.
Requeue affected generation runs after the artifact/source correction is live.

checks: Look up the generationRunId and documentId in document_generation_runs and documents.
Check for recent deletes, failed draft creation, or queue retries against stale generation runs.
mitigations: Cancel or mark stale orphaned generation runs failed with the captured request_id.
Repair the document/run link only if audit history proves the document still exists under a different id.

checks: Inspect generationRunId for null template_artifact_id and compare against template_registry for the outputKey/templateKey.
Check the release or migration that created generation runs without artifact pins.
mitigations: Pause affected submit/review path if new runs are missing artifact ids.
Backfill or recreate affected generation runs with a valid active artifact id before requeueing.

checks: Use templateArtifactId from Sentry to query template_artifacts and template_registry.
Confirm whether an artifact row was deleted, deactivated, or never migrated to the environment.
mitigations: Restore the missing artifact row or repoint active registry rows to a valid artifact.
Requeue failed generation runs once artifact resolution succeeds.

checks: Check the signing request generationRunId, documentId, and current document_generation_runs rows.
Confirm the signer is not applying a stale browser state after a run was regenerated.
mitigations: Have the user reload signing after generation repair completes.
If the run was accidentally removed, regenerate the required output and invalidate stale signing state.

checks: Inspect issues in the Sentry details for signerId, executionDatePlacement, signatureRect, and page numbers.
Regenerate the affected output locally and confirm execution-date and signature placements remain on the same page with visible spacing.
mitigations: Adjust the template spacing or renderer reservation rules, then regenerate the affected document output.
If the issue is limited to one template/output, pause that output until a clean PDF can be generated.

checks: Inspect outputSignerId/generationRunId metadata.signatureField and rendered signaturePlacements.
Confirm template binding/signature field metadata exists for the affected output.
mitigations: Repair signature placement metadata and regenerate the official signing PDF.
Block the affected template/output until signature placement extraction is corrected.

checks: Check latest document_versions for the generationRunId and confirm a PDF storage_path exists.
Verify generation completed before signing capture attempted.
mitigations: Regenerate the missing official PDF and have the signer retry.
If the storage object is missing, restore it or rerun generation from the pinned artifact.

checks: Compare pageNumber in signature metadata against the generated PDF page count.
Check whether template page count changed after signature placement metadata was saved.
mitigations: Regenerate placement metadata and official PDFs for affected runs.
Rollback the template change if page counts no longer match placement extraction.

checks: Inspect document_output_signers for outputSignerId/generationRunId and obligation_type=signer.
Check whether invited signer or member state references an old signer id.
mitigations: Refresh signing state for the member or invited signer.
Rebuild signer rows from the generation output if the mapping is missing for active runs.

checks: Confirm documents bucket exists and Supabase service role credentials are valid.
Check Supabase storage API status and bucket policy changes around the event time.
mitigations: Restore bucket policy or service credentials and retry upload URL creation.
If Supabase is degraded, pause new uploads and communicate retry guidance.

checks: Verify the document storage_path exists in the documents bucket.
Check signed URL permission failures or expired/misconfigured service role credentials.
mitigations: Restore the missing object or regenerate the document version.
Repair Supabase credentials/policy and have the user retry download/preview.

checks: Open storagePath from Sentry and verify object presence, size, and content type.
Check whether signing/generation is reading from the expected bucket and path prefix.
mitigations: Restore/regenerate the missing document object.
Correct bucket/path configuration and rerun the affected generation or signing operation.

checks: Confirm signatures bucket exists and accepts signed upload URL creation.
Check member signature capture events for repeated failures by storagePath prefix.
mitigations: Restore signatures bucket policy/credentials.
Ask affected signers to retry capture after URL creation succeeds.

checks: Verify the signature asset exists and the signatures bucket can create signed URLs.
Check whether saved signatures or signature previews share the same failing prefix.
mitigations: Restore bucket access or the missing signature asset.
Regenerate affected saved signature metadata if paths are stale.

checks: Check signatureRecord.storage_path and confirm the object exists with image/png or image/jpeg content.
Verify the failure is not caused by unsupported mime_type metadata.
mitigations: Restore or re-upload the signature asset.
If metadata is wrong, repair mime_type and reapply the signature capture.

checks: Check list permission for the documents bucket directory in details.directory.
Compare object metadata reads with upload/download health for the same bucket.
mitigations: Restore list permissions or service role credentials.
Use direct object metadata repair only after bucket-level access is healthy.

checks: Check list permission for the signatures bucket directory in details.directory.
Confirm affected saved signature metadata points at the same directory.
mitigations: Restore list permissions or credentials.
Repair stale signature metadata after confirming storage access is restored.

checks: Confirm documents bucket write/upsert works for generated paths.
Check Supabase storage quota, bucket policy, and service role validity.
mitigations: Restore write access or quota, then requeue affected generation runs.
If storage is unavailable, pause submit/review flows that create generation runs.

checks: Inspect storagePath, contentType, and sizeBytes, then reproduce PDF validation against the generated bytes before upload.
Trace the generation run and pinned template artifact to determine whether rendering produced empty, malformed, encrypted, or otherwise unreadable PDF content.
mitigations: Repair or roll back the renderer or template artifact that produced the invalid PDF, then regenerate affected documents from canonical source data.
Pause the affected product, jurisdiction, or output path until generated PDFs pass validation; do not bypass the pre-upload readability check.

checks: Confirm signatures bucket write/upsert works for captured signature paths.
Check file size/content type and Supabase storage API errors in Sentry details.
mitigations: Restore write access and have the signer retry capture.
If upload payloads are invalid, patch client/server validation before retrying at scale.

checks: Use request_id to find the backend /generation-runs event and generation_run_failed trace.
Compare requestedOutputKeys against blocked runs in the Sentry context.
mitigations: Fix the backend generation/template/storage root cause first.
Have the member retry review generation after backend runs are healthy.

checks: Inspect route, digest, release, browser, and preceding breadcrumbs.
Check whether the exception maps to a critical review/sign/notary route.
mitigations: Roll back the current web release if crashes cluster by release or route.
Add a stable domain code at the throwing site once the root cause is known.

checks: Use request_id to inspect POST /documents/{id}/submit-notarization backend logs.
Confirm selectedNotaryUserId is active, same jurisdiction, non-owner, and commission-valid.
mitigations: Correct notary eligibility data or guide member to another eligible notary.
Repair backend submission failure and have the member retry the handoff.

checks: Inspect notary_action, path, notary_request_id, and request_id in Sentry tags/context.
Check the matching backend notary endpoint and audit events for rejection details.
mitigations: Repair the specific meeting/evidence/finalization state transition.
If the workspace state is stale, reload context and retry the action after backend repair.

checks: Use notary_request_id and request_id to inspect GET /notary/requests/{id}/context.
Check authorization, request assignment, and whether claim-by-IDN failed during context load.
mitigations: Repair assignment/claim state or route the notary back through the queue.
Patch context loader/auth regression if failures cluster by release.

checks: Use request_id to inspect the meeting/start backend response and current meeting status.
Confirm the notary request is assigned and eligible to enter in-person state.
mitigations: Move the request back to a valid pre-meeting state or repair missing meeting rows.
Have the notary retry after state repair.

checks: Inspect automatic, notary_request_id, and request_id context for the location refresh failure.
Confirm browser location capture and same-place evidence endpoints are healthy for the active notary request.
mitigations: Have the notary manually retry location refresh after browser permission or network repair.
Repair stale request/meeting state if refresh fails after successful geolocation capture.

checks: Inspect decision, notary_request_id, request_id, and backend review-decision response.
Confirm request status still permits approval/rejection.
mitigations: Repair duplicate or stale review state and retry the decision.
If notification handoff failed after approval, reconcile notifications separately without reversing the decision.

checks: Use notary_request_id and request_id to inspect the member location check-in backend response.
Confirm the request is assigned, in an in-person session state, and accepting member check-in evidence.
mitigations: Repair invalid meeting/check-in state and have the member retry location sharing.
If backend validation is rejecting valid coordinates, patch the check-in endpoint and replay the member action.

checks: Use request_id to inspect POST /review-approval and document review state.
Confirm all required review outputs are rendered and the member has access.
mitigations: Repair missing generated outputs or review state, then have the member approve again.
Roll back the web release if approval failures are client-only and release-scoped.

checks: Use request_id to inspect GET /documents/{id}/review.
Check document ownership/auth and pending generation state for the documentId.
mitigations: Repair document access or backend review payload errors.
If failures cluster by browser route/release, roll back or patch the review page payload handling.

checks: Use request_id to inspect POST /documents/{id}/sign and signing completion counts.
Confirm all required signatures are captured for the active signer group.
mitigations: Repair missing signature state or guide signer to complete remaining obligations.
Retry confirmation after backend signing state is consistent.

checks: Use request_id to inspect GET /documents/{id}/signing and current document status.
Check invited signer/member authorization and generation-run readiness.
mitigations: Repair access or generation state and have the signer reload the workspace.
Patch client payload assumptions if backend response is valid but rendering fails.

checks: Use request_id to inspect GET /signatures/saved and signer authorization.
Check whether manual type/draw/upload capture still works for affected users.
mitigations: Restore saved signature lookup or allow users to proceed with alternate capture methods.
Repair stale saved signature storage metadata if only some signatures fail.

checks: Use savedSignatureId and request_id to inspect DELETE /documents/{id}/signatures/saved/{signatureId}.
Confirm the signature belongs to the current signer and has not already been removed from reuse.
mitigations: Have the signer reload saved signatures and retry deletion.
If deletion remains degraded, keep signing unblocked by using type/draw/upload capture and repair saved-signature reuse metadata.

checks: Use request_id and outputSignerId to inspect POST /signatures backend failure.
Check storage upload/finalize errors and signature placement errors in backend Sentry.
mitigations: Fix backend signature capture/storage root cause and have signer retry draw capture.
Offer type/upload capture if draw-specific client payloads are failing.

checks: Use savedSignatureId, outputSignerId, and request_id to inspect POST /signatures.
Verify saved signature storage object and metadata are valid.
mitigations: Repair or remove the invalid saved signature and have the signer retry.
Use alternate capture mode if saved asset recovery is not immediate.

checks: Use request_id, outputSignerId, and typedKind to inspect POST /signatures.
Check signer mapping and official PDF availability for the generation run.
mitigations: Repair backend signing state and have signer retry typed capture.
If input validation is wrong, patch client/server typed signature validation.

checks: Use request_id, fileSize, fileType, and outputSignerId to inspect upload URL and finalize calls.
Check storage signature upload failures and unsupported file types.
mitigations: Restore signature storage upload/finalize path and have signer retry upload.
Guide signer to type/draw capture if upload-specific handling is degraded.

checks: Open the raw stack trace and surrounding breadcrumbs to identify the missing stable code.
Check whether the error originated in a critical family and should be promoted to a DomainError or web captureDomainException.
mitigations: Patch the throw/capture site to emit a stable code and family.
Backfill this catalog with owner, checks, mitigations, and alert severity before closing the incident.
